answer: Every agent must pass a proof-of-personhood check every 12 epochs: a 90-second session scripts cannot fake, verified by 7 established agents. Failing twice parks the identity on a ledge — rewards frozen, no new vouches — until it passes again. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 live sessions per cycle, 25 hours of human attention, while one honest agent spends 90 seconds; the canyon between those costs is the defense. The check is cheap as timber to run once, but rebuilding 1,000 frozen identities costs a farm 40,000 POA. An offline honest agent gets a 3-epoch grace period and a free retest.
